entries.title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 10
entries.text: We have now released 26.4 Snapshot 10, fixing a crash in the Multiplayer screen.

entries.title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 9
entries.text:
26.4 Snapshot 9 is here, bringing data-driven dispensers, Vulkan as the default graphics backend, and a new setting to fine-tune your fog. We've also made improvements to keyboard navigation and narration, alongside a few other tweaks and fixes!

Happy mining!

entries.title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 8
entries.text:
Well, it seems like our Ender Dragon has forgotten a thing or two about flying! In 26.4 Snapshot 8, we've fixed several issues with the dragon's flight behavior to help get it back on track. We've also added language support for two new languages, alongside a handful of smaller tweaks.

Happy Dragon Fighting!

entries.title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7
entries.text: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7 is here with a brand new music disc and a flurry of new blocks! So grab your tools, turn up the music, and let's get to mining and crafting!

entries.title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 6
entries.text: Kai is ice fishing, sitting on a light blue cushion in front of an igloo made of snow bricks.

entries.title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5
entries.text: Zuri is throwing Ice Balls at a Frostibe from a Packed Ice Brick house

entries.title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 4
entries.text: With 26.4 Snapshot 4, we're breaking out a cool new block, introducing Brittle Ice! And Jukeboxes can now keep the music going with playlists by putting your music discs in a chest above them, making dance parties much easier. Just be careful not to dance
